name: explicit react rules: reactRules is refused on a package of another role
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "is a configuration error on a package of another role"

name: explicit react rules: a value that is neither client nor bindings is refused
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/gates.test.mts -t "names a role that has no React rules to take"

name: explicit react rules: an explicit package is under the lint of the role it names
test: pnpm vitest run kit/eslint.config.test.mts -t "an explicit package with reactRules: client gets the client's lint"

name: explicit react rules: reactRules: bindings gives the bindings' ban, not the client's
replace: return role === "explicit" && reactRules !== undefined ? "client" : role === "explicit" ? reactRules : role;
test: pnpm vitest run kit/eslint.config.test.mts -t "an explicit package with reactRules: bindings gets"

name: explicit react rules: an explicit package without reactRules is under no React rule
test: pnpm vitest run kit/eslint.config.test.mts -t "an explicit package without reactRules gets none"

name: explicit react rules: the policy check finds an explicit package without reactRules
find: const reactRole = declared === undefined ? undefined : reactRoleOf(declared);
replace: const reactRole = declared === undefined ? undefined : declared.role === "explicit" ? "client" : reactRoleOf(declared);
test: pnpm vitest run kit/check-react-policies.test.mts -t "names an explicit package that imports React without reactRules"

name: explicit react rules: the policy check judges an explicit package by the role it names
find: const reactRole = declared === undefined ? undefined : reactRoleOf(declared);
replace: const reactRole = declared === undefined ? undefined : declared.role;
test: pnpm vitest run kit/check-react-policies.test.mts -t "passes, and says how many packages it judged"

name: explicit react rules: an explicit client's compiler declaration is held to a build it does not have
test: pnpm vitest run kit/check-react-policies.test.mts -t "passes, and says how many packages it judged"
